text: The framing rule (ADR-0073): the active ADR directory is **not a museum**. Old ADRs survive only for invariants that don't conflict with the spine; otherwise they're folded/amended/retired in place. Git history is the archive. The temporary `docs/new-arch/` packet was retired. [...] A standing **follow-up rule**: a PR touching a folded/amended ADR's implementation area must keep old public-surface counts flat-or-decreasing, or update the owning ADR in place — no new correction docs that leave stale guidance behind. Each architecture slice carries a deletion ledger (old doors deleted/privatized, new concepts, net permanent concepts), and ratchets prevent old-pattern counts from rising.
